step1_analysis.description: A two-stage fully differential continuous-time comparator used in the automatic switched-capacitor (SC) tuning loop of the frequency synthesizer. Each stage consists of a PMOS differential pair with diode-connected NMOS loads, followed by NMOS common-source amplifiers with PMOS current source loads to provide high voltage gain for resolving small voltage differences.

paper_reference.title: A 900-MHz 2.5-mA CMOS Frequency Synthesizer with an Automatic SC Tuning Loop

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the comparator.

sky130_expected.calculation: The circuit has 7 current branches (1 bias, 2 tails, 4 CS loads). Assuming a 10uA bias current, the total current is 70uA. Power = 70uA * 1.8V = 126 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a standard 10uA bias current scaled across the 1:1 current mirrors.

dc_gain.description: Maximum low-frequency voltage gain from input to output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Stage 1 diff pair gain: gm2/gm10 ≈ sqrt(up/un) ≈ 0.43. Stage 1 CS amp gain: gm4 * (ro4 || ro16) ≈ 116. Total stage 1 gain ≈ 50 V/V. Stage 2 is identical. Total DC gain ≈ 50 * 50 = 2500 V/V (68 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law approximations for SKY130 parameters (un*Cox=270u, up*Cox=50u, lambda=0.1).

input_offset_voltage.description: Systematic input offset voltage (difference between IN and VLOW when output crosses VDD/2).

sky130_expected.calculation: The circuit is perfectly symmetric by design.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Systematic offset should be near zero. Random offset (mismatch) is not simulated in standard TT corner.

propagation_delay.description: Average time delay between input crossing the reference voltage and output crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RC time constants of the internal nodes. With 10uA bias and small parasitic capacitances of 5u/0.5u devices.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical delay for a two-stage continuous-time comparator in 130nm with ~10uA branch currents.

sky130_expected.calculation: The CS amplifiers with PMOS current source loads can swing nearly rail-to-rail.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited only by the Vdsat of the output NMOS and PMOS transistors.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power consumption, DC transfer characteristics (gain, offset), and transient response (propagation delay, output swing) of the comparator. Note: The widths of the CS amplifier NMOS transistors (XM4, XM5, XM3, XM8) have been adjusted to 10u to properly balance the 1:1 PMOS current mirrors and prevent the outputs from railing out systematically.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Continuous-Time Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Adjusted W for CS NMOS to balance the 10uA current mirrors
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm4=10u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm5=10u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm19=5u L_xm19=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm3=10u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm8=10u L_xm8=0.5u

XM12 N_BIAS N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM16 N_OUT1_L N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM15 N_TAIL1 N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM7 N_OUT1_R N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM2 N_D1_L IN N_TAIL1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N_D1_R VLOW N_TAIL1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM10 N_D1_L N_D1_L GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM4 N_OUT1_L N_D1_L GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM17 N_D1_R N_D1_R GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM5 N_OUT1_R N_D1_R GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM18 L N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}
XM13 N_TAIL2 N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM6 L_BAR N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM14 N_D2_L N_OUT1_L N_TAIL2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM19 N_D2_R N_OUT1_R N_TAIL2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm19} w={W_xm19}
XM11 N_D2_L N_D2_L GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM3 L N_D2_L GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM9 N_D2_R N_D2_R GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM8 L_BAR N_D2_R GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VREF VLOW 0 0.9
IBIAS N_BIAS 0 10u
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 PULSE(0.8 1.0 2n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 10n)

.control
  * 1. Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. DC Sweep for Transfer Curve, Offset, and Gain
  dc VIN 0.85 0.95 10u
  meas dc vth_L when v(L)=0.9
  let offset = vth_L - 0.9
  print offset
  let gain_dc = deriv(v(L))
  meas dc max_gain max gain_dc

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Delay and Swing
  tran 10p 15n
  meas tran tpd_rise trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(L) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran tpd_fall trig v(IN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(L) val=0.9 fall=1
  let tpd_avg = (tpd_rise + tpd_fall) / 2
  print tpd_avg
  meas tran vout_max max v(L)
  meas tran vout_min min v(L)
  
  quit
.endc
